title: Dev Log Bot is Live
body: The Discord bot is online. Post in the announcement channel and it syncs straight into this Dev Log automatically.

title: Roblox: Search & Pickup System
body: Searchable objects and a shared item system are written. Testing in Studio.

title: Roblox: Facility Doors & Keycards
body: Doors slide open with ProximityPrompt. Locked doors require a keycard from the item system.

title: Roblox: Sanity / Myth System
body: Core analog horror systems written: sanity meter, darkness vignette, TV static, flickering lights and a jumpscare at zero sanity.

title: Roblox: Player Movement & Stamina
body: Movement foundation done: walk/run with a stamina system and exhaustion state.

title: Website Launch · Dev Log is Open
body:
First version of the website is live. From now on, all drafts, update status, feedback, and guides will be organized here.
The Discord server is live too — everyone is welcome to join.
